notes.en: Alif. The first letter. A tall vertical stroke. Often carries the long /aa/ vowel or hosts the hamza (ء). Does not connect to the letter that follows it (going left in RTL), so it always ends a word-segment.
notes.ar: ألف. أول حروف الهجاء. تكتب خطًا عموديًا. لا تتصل بما بعدها.

notes.en: Baa. A shallow bowl with one dot below. Connects on both sides — so it has four positional forms.
notes.ar: باء. كأس مع نقطة تحتها. تتصل من الجانبين.

notes.en: Taa. Same body shape as baa, but with two dots above instead of one below. /t/ sound.
notes.ar: تاء. مثل الباء في الشكل لكن النقطتان فوقها.

notes.en: Thaa. Same body as baa and taa, but with three dots above. Pronounced like the /th/ in 'think'.
notes.ar: ثاء. ثلاث نقاط فوق نفس شكل الباء.

notes.en: Jiim. A deep curve with a dot inside (below the curve). /j/ sound in standard Arabic. The Egyptian dialect pronounces it as a hard /g/.
notes.ar: جيم. منحنى مع نقطة في الوسط.

notes.en: Haa. Same shape as jiim but without any dot. A guttural /h/ sound made deeper in the throat than English h.
notes.ar: حاء. مثل الجيم بدون نقطة.

notes.en: Khaa. Same shape as jiim and Haa, with one dot above. /kh/ as in Scottish 'loch' or German 'Bach'.
notes.ar: خاء. مثل الحاء مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Daal. A small angular hook. /d/ sound. Does not connect to the letter that follows it.
notes.ar: دال. خطاف صغير. لا تتصل بما بعدها.

notes.en: Dhaal. Same shape as daal with one dot above. /th/ sound as in 'this'.
notes.ar: ذال. مثل الدال مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Raa. A descending curve that dips below the baseline. Rolled /r/, like in Spanish or Italian. Does not connect to the letter that follows it.
notes.ar: راء. منحنى ينزل تحت السطر. لا تتصل بما بعدها.

notes.en: Zaay. Same shape as raa with one dot above. /z/ sound.
notes.ar: زاي. مثل الراء مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Siin. Three teeth followed by a tail bowl. /s/ sound.
notes.ar: سين. ثلاث أسنان متبوعة بكأس.

notes.en: Shiin. Same shape as siin with three dots above. /sh/ sound.
notes.ar: شين. مثل السين مع ثلاث نقاط فوقها.

notes.en: Saad. An emphatic /s/ — produced with the tongue lower and the throat slightly constricted. Looks like an open loop followed by a tail.
notes.ar: صاد. حلقة مفتوحة مع ذيل.

notes.en: Daad. Same shape as Saad with one dot above. Emphatic /d/. Considered the signature sound of Arabic — Arabic is sometimes called 'the language of Daad' (لغة الضاد).
notes.ar: ضاد. حرف العربية المميز. مثل الصاد مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Taa (emphatic). An emphatic /t/. The letter looks like a loop with a tall vertical stroke beside it.
notes.ar: طاء. حرف مفخم. حلقة وعمود.

notes.en: DHaa. Same shape as Taa (emphatic) with one dot above. Emphatic /th/ as in 'this'.
notes.ar: ظاء. مثل الطاء مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Ain. A uniquely Arabic consonant — a voiced pharyngeal sound produced deep in the throat. Often transliterated with a forward apostrophe (ʿ). No equivalent in English.
notes.ar: عين. حرف عربي مميز ينطق من أقصى الحلق.

notes.en: Ghain. Same shape as ain with one dot above. A sound similar to the French 'r' in 'Paris', a voiced gargling sound.
notes.ar: غين. مثل العين مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Faa. A small circle with a dot above and a tail. /f/ sound.
notes.ar: فاء. حلقة مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Qaaf. Looks similar to faa but with two dots above and a deeper tail that drops below the line. A uvular /q/ — produced at the back of the throat.
notes.ar: قاف. مثل الفاء مع نقطتين وذيل أعمق.

notes.en: Kaaf. /k/ sound. The isolated form has a small inner mark (the kaaf 'kashida').
notes.ar: كاف. مع علامة داخلية في الشكل المستقل.

notes.en: Laam. /l/ sound. Pairs with alif to form the famous ligature 'lam-alif' (لا), which means 'no'.
notes.ar: لام. تتصل مع الألف لتكوّن (لا).

notes.en: Miim. /m/ sound. A small circle (the head) followed by a tail that descends below the line in isolated and final forms.
notes.ar: ميم. حلقة وذيل ينزل تحت السطر.

notes.en: Nuun. /n/ sound. A deeper bowl than baa with one dot above. Initial and medial forms look identical to baa/taa/thaa — the dot tells them apart.
notes.ar: نون. كأس عميق مع نقطة فوقها.

notes.en: Haa (light h). /h/ sound, lighter than Haa (the emphatic). Shape varies dramatically across its four positions — the medial form is a small loop, the initial is a top loop.
notes.ar: هاء. شكلها يتغيّر كثيرًا بحسب موضعها.

notes.en: Waaw. A small loop with a descending tail. Carries the long /uu/ vowel and also serves as /w/. Does not connect to the letter that follows it.
notes.ar: واو. حلقة مع ذيل. لا تتصل بما بعدها.

notes.en: Yaa. The 28th letter. Carries the long /ii/ vowel and also serves as /y/. Initial and medial forms look like baa with two dots below; isolated and final forms have a deeper descending tail.
notes.ar: ياء. آخر حروف الهجاء. تحمل الياء الطويلة.
